text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors.

City Council on April 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members of Council to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors for a term starting from the Annual General Meeting in 2025 to the Annual General Meeting in 2026: Councillor Paul Ainslie Councillor Chris Moise
